facts.text: The report describes University College's 'significant architectural heritage' and records heritage-building constraints on the revitalization.
Project list includes a limited-use/limited-application elevator in the central tower of the front (southern) wing, with additional accessible upgrades throughout the building.
The report states that barrier-free washrooms are not available on the same floor level as required by the Ontario Building Code.

The report states that Ontario Building Code amendments under Regulation 191/14, in force January 1, 2015, apply to new projects, major retrofits, common space and circulation areas, and change in use.
Barrier-free paths of travel 'must also strive to provide' proper door width, hallway passing space, curb-ramp dimensions and signage, 'within the heritage building constraints'.

The Reading Room project includes a barrier-free, gender-neutral washroom. The report notes that the existing preparation kitchen conflicts with paths of travel and that there are no accessible washrooms.
